kim_customer_success: Heads-up — Astral Finance needs a temporary regional allowlist + burst QPS for their EU + APAC demos next Tue-Wed. Renewal call Friday; theyre concerned about perf regressions. Can we provision a 72h window with auto-revoke? Legal requires EU-only routing for some calls and pinned egress IPs. I created CS-5103: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-5103
aj_ops: On it. Can you paste the customer IP CIDRs and desired QPS per region? Also confirm customer_id (cust_astro_42) so I can tag the change and set auto-revoke.
kim_customer_success: IPs: 203.0.113.0/24 (apac), 198.51.100.64/26 (eu). Target: eu-west 120 QPS, apac-south 80 QPS. Window: 2026-04-07T08:00Z -> 2026-04-10T08:00Z. Auto-revoke = yes. Rebecca (renewals) wants a short exec note about risk and perf expectations.
aj_ops: Thanks. I'll stage this in sandbox then do a canary in prod. @lina_network please confirm NAT/pinning feasibility for eu-west egress and any edge tagging we need. Planning: allowlist + per-customer rate override + control-plane auto-revoke tag.
lina_network: We can pin egress for those CIDRs on our edge nodes. Need to add policy to edge-route table and attach route-tag "astral-demo". No port changes required. ETA ~2h after ticket is approved.
ops-bot: Ticket CS-5103 updated: assignee=aj_ops, labels=[allowlist, temporary-burst, auto-revoke], sla=4h
rebecca_csm: Please add one-paragraph risk note: if we fail to hit throughput/latency targets during demo, they may delay renewal. Id like a screenshot of expected p99 latency under the bumped load to share in the renewal call.
aj_ops: Will attach perf run. Quick config payload I'll apply to control plane for sandbox/prod testing:
```json
{"customer_id":"cust_astro_42","regions":{"eu-west":{"qps":120,"ips":["198.51.100.64/26"]},"apac-south":{"qps":80,"ips":["203.0.113.0/24"]}},"auto_revoke":"2026-04-10T08:00Z","note":"astral finance demo - temporary"}
```
kim_customer_success: :thumbsup: Also enable helpdesk logging for this customer with 30d retention and attach alerts (p50/p95/p99 delta >20%). Add a short runbook for CS triage steps if errors spike.
aj_ops: Will do. Plan: 1) apply sandbox allowlist+rate, 2) run perf at target QPS, 3) canary prod push, 4) full prod rollout 30m later. Expected prod rollout: 2026-04-07T07:30Z (canary) / 2026-04-07T08:00Z full.
lina_network: Edge routes applied in sandbox; canary test results look good: p99 ~ 210ms at 150 concurrent connections, no route drops. Scheduling prod push.
aj_ops: Prod push completed. Auto-revoke scheduled in control plane for 2026-04-10T08:00Z. Runbook + logs link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/astral-demo. Change ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-7821
rebecca_csm: Great work — Ill capture this in the renewal notes and update the customer. Closing loop, thanks team :tada:
